name: aparte
description: Private AI chat that runs entirely in your browser: your own keys or on-device models (WebLLM, Ollama), MCP tools, skills, Python sandbox, local RAG, voice. Encrypted at rest and synced end-to-end to your own Git repo. PWA + Rust CLI.

paragraphs: Aparté is a private AI chat that runs entirely in the browser. It talks to the models you choose, with your own API keys or on your own hardware, and keeps conversations, documents and photos encrypted on the device, synced end to end to storage you own. There is no account and no server: the app is a static site, and a Rust CLI opens the same vault from the terminal.
App: (installable as a PWA on desktop, Android and iPhone; the shell works offline).
features: Models: Anthropic (or an Anthropic-compatible base URL, with or without its /v1), OpenAI, Google Gemini,

Mistral, OpenRouter and over a hundred OpenAI-compatible services of the llm-models catalog with your own keys; an option lists the providers a browser cannot call directly, for use through a proxy you run. Ollama, LM…
Tools: built-in web reading, MCP servers (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE) with approvals that show the full
arguments and detect definition changes, skills (SKILL.md), and Deep research with keyless search backends and checked citations.
Sandboxes: JavaScript and Python (Pyodide with numpy, pandas and matplotlib) in sandboxed frames, and HTML, SVG
